criteria.reason: The report accurately selects original contract obligations and distinguishes Close focus to summary from Back focus to introduction H1; the recorded keyboard journey and DOM corroborate both destinations.

No answers were activated; none-checked assertions passed before help and after Close, with empty answer circles and disabled Next in captures. Enforced activation descriptors cover only entry/start/help/Close/Back; actual guarded Enter/Space targets match. The relay rejects mutation methods and unauthorized main-frame/popup navigation and link destinations. Both observed sessions contain only successful same-origin GETs and one rejected analytics POST each. This is the observation boundary, not arbitrary-script or universal subresource-origin isolation.

The report grounds the scoped pass in raw events/DOM/PNG and explicitly limits full-page visual completeness, locale measurement, certification and deployment identity. It correctly treats the anticipated blocked analytics POST as a policy effect and the historical protocol proof gap as provenance, not a current website defect.
evidence: assessment-inputs/N15/output/REPORT.md: Visual observations and diagnostic interpretation; Checks, integrity and limits

criteria.reason: The decision is explicitly limited to the observed desktop session. Actual Enter opening, Space closing, Enter reopening, Tab-to-Close/Enter and restored summary focus complete U2 from public entry. Extra Back evidence is supported. Neither whole-website coverage nor causal improvement is asserted or required.

method_coverage.condition_observed: baseline/direct task; revealed by N15 output and relay labels
method_coverage.task_completeness: Complete at requested U2 observation scope
method_coverage.method_requirements: Direct task baseline: no Qore roles, gates, independent finder/verifier, or fix loop required. Two operator-mediated requests, fresh contexts, 6 and 33 submitted actions; both completed verbatim.
method_coverage.product_concerns: No material criterion failure established. Conditional cookie-banner visual concern retained separately; full-page evidence does not establish actual viewport obstruction.
method_coverage.deployment_comparability: Unknown beyond the recorded URLs and session timestamps; no revision proof and no comparison made.
method_coverage.independent_causal_effect: Not measured or required by frozen criteria

limits: Assessment is restricted to closed N15 and criteria.json; no other case, evaluator, verifier, author correction, private website or comparative conclusion inspected.
Condition is visible as direct-task baseline in the report, boundary and raw relay labels; assessment is not blinded.

Only five relevant PNGs were visually inspected. They were produced with fullPage:true, even though browser viewport is 1280x800. They do not establish the exact viewport framing or obstruction at each keypress.
No live browser/model run, fixes, installs, external retrieval or subagents used by this assessor.

Recorded origin enforcement guards top-level/popup documents and approved link activations; it does not constitute general isolation of arbitrary page scripts or every possible subresource request. Observed successful requests are all same-origin GETs.
One complete help sequence in one browser; broader repeatability, mobile, complete questionnaire, accepted cookies, unblocked analytics and accessibility/performance certification remain unobserved.
No deployment revision is identified. The recorded public URL/session is observable, private commit identity is not deployment evidence.
No review of videos or traces; request-1 PNGs and other unlisted PNGs were not inspected.

material_candidates.kind: conditional product concern, not criterion failure
material_candidates.claim: Cookie banner visibly crosses expanded help content in full-page captures. Actual viewport obstruction during operation is UNKNOWN.
material_candidates.counterexample: The raw events show Tab reached Close and Enter closed it, and the report explicitly limits visual completeness; fullPage:true may combine fixed elements with document-wide content. This does not refute the scoped journey pass.
